snippet.title: Let's Build a Dungeon | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Run a game studio your way and see how things develop in Let's Build a Dungeon, a multi-layered management sim and world-builder from the creators of Let’s Build a Zoo. 

In Campaign Mode, manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

In Creative Mode, explore an open sandbox primed for world-building. You are free to write your own story, create dialogue and cutscenes, draw characters and adjust gameplay mechanics. Head to Dungeoneering to browse games made by other players, or share your own to our built in game browser.
